findings.finding_text: CLI rerun lane ignores rerunAwareProvision's failure contract — partial upserts strand unreported (createdInAttempt [] by design), no post-snapshot, no compensation (2-reviewer convergent)

findings.finding_text: Driver compensation deletes ANY post\pre diff bank — including probe banks of concurrently-running legs and operator-created banks (attribution inversion of AC3's own guard)
findings.label: MED

findings.finding_text: CLI rerun lock is the un-hardened variant: age-only steal (dead holder blocks 900s), no lock-dir mkdir, unguarded releaseRerun in finally can crash after the envelope printed (2-reviewer convergent)
